items.title: The Pontryagin-style dual module of a module is injective
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the module constructed by dualising a module with respect to the Pontryagin dual of the ring is injective, and the proof is a 12-line argument in two reductions. It first identifies the module as a product of copies of the dual of the ring, so that it suffices to prove injectivity of that single module, and then computes the module of homomorphisms into it as the Pontryagin dual of the source, concluding with the exactness of the duality functor proved in the same block. The identification as a product and the adjunction computation are the two steps, and both are displayed.
